title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
first_seen_basis: GitHub issue created_at; earliest evidenced repository observation
hf_date_evidence: No HF recommendation date asserted by this watch evidence package.

object.quote: Its output includes both the numerical representation and the code that runs it.

feedback.quote: The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model.

persistence.quote: Candidate versions and experiments are recorded so that the final model can be connected to the revisions that produced it.

study.quote: We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously.

verified_scope_policy: feed/taxonomy.yaml and feed/prompts/harness_gate.md: subsequent tasks OR improvement rounds, with actual external artifact modification
reason_zh: 评测对象是编码 Agent 构造的压缩权重和对应推理实现。多轮 PPL 反馈改进的是外部模型研发产物，正文未显示 Agent 自身的提示、工具或控制程序被反馈修改并继承。可归一般 RSI / AI 研发评测，排除出 Harness 专题；不能把推理代码等同 Agent Harness。
persistence_boundary: External compression candidates are retained during search; no feedback-driven inheritance of the agent harness is demonstrated.
limitations: Not a claim that compression research is unrelated to RSI; only the Harness topic boundary is excluded.
Scope and identity checked; no experimental reproduction or full numerical recertification.
summary_zh: CompressionBench 评测编码 Agent 能否在存储与时间预算下构造压缩权重及推理实现，并以独立测试验证产物。PPL 反馈指导的是模型压缩研发过程，没有展示 Agent 自身 Harness 的反馈演化，因此归一般 RSI / AI 研发评测，不计入 Harness 篇数。
summary_en: CompressionBench evaluates whether coding agents can construct compressed weights and executable inference implementations under storage and time budgets, with independent artifact verification. Its feedback loop improves model-compression artifacts rather than the agent harness, so it belongs to general RSI / AI R&D evaluation, outside the Harness topic.
